title: Agent Execution Interruption: Unexpected Workflow Termination During Multi-Agent Tasks
body:
**Bug Description**
claude code ist constantly just stopping. having three agents running and they just stop in the middle. asking them to continue works for a while.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: WarpTerminal
- Version: 1.0.53
- Feedback ID: 419c14a3-a63f-4f70-811a-53109fc10589

**Errors**
```json
[{"error":"Error: Command failed: security find-generic-password -a $USER -w -s \"Claude Code\"\nsecurity: SecKeychainSearchCopyNext: The specified item could not be found in the keychain.\n\n    at genericNodeError (node:internal/errors:984:15)\n    at wrappedFn (node:internal/errors:538:14)\n    at checkExecSyncError (node:child_process:890:11)\n    at execSync (node:child_process:962:15)\n    at AI (file:///Users/r/.nvm/versions/node/v21.6.1/lib/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/cli.js:728:6320)\n    at file:///Users/r/.nvm/versions/node/v21.6.1/lib/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/cli.js:640:16554\n    at Q (file:///Users/r/.nvm/versions/node/v21.6.1/lib/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/cli.js:542:14406)\n    at MF (file:///Users/r/.nvm/versions/node/v21.6.1/lib/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/cli.js:640:14339)\n    at zX (file:///Users/r/.nvm/versions/node/v21.6.1/lib/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/cli.js:640:13205)\n    at MB (file:///Users/r/.nvm/versions/node/v21.6.1/lib/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/cli.js:640:19174)","timestamp":"2025-07-17T03:59:43.620Z"}]
```
author: avrabe

top_comments.author: prvnsmpth
top_comments.body: The latest version of the client (1.0.53) was published around 5 hours ago. It was working just fine until around 10 mins ago, and then I started noticing this unexpected stopping behaviour. So I think it's an issue with the backend server and not the client.
